revision_notes: Cited source (dig.watch) is a generic country digital profile that does not itself discuss sub-national participation in data exchange, so it only weakly supports the score. Fresher, more specific evidence was found and checked: Comoros's data exchange/interoperability platform is being built as part of the AfDB-funded PADEC project (agreement 2024, platform launched 19 May 2025 alongside the national Tier-III data centre) under ANADEN, a purely national-level agency. No island-level government (Ngazidja, Anjouan, Mohéli) participation in this exchange platform is documented anywhere. Score of 1 (National level only) is confirmed and, if anything, strengthened by the newer PADEC/data-centre launch evidence; year updated to 2025 to reflect the vintage of the newest supporting source.
revised_comments: Comoros's government data exchange capability is being built exclusively at the national level. The interoperability and data-exchange platform forms part of the AfDB-financed Project to Support Digitisation of the Comorian Economy (PADEC), implemented by the national digital development agency ANADEN, with the associated national Tier-III data centre inaugurated in May 2025. There is no evidence of participation by the autonomous island governments (Ngazidja, Anjouan, Mohéli) or other sub-national bodies in this exchange infrastructure; engagement remains confined to national government institutions.
